scripts.build: npm run build -w @emobility/api && npm run build -w @emobility/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @emobility/api && concurrently -k -n api,types,web "npm run dev -w @emobility/api" "npm run watch -w @emobility/api" "npm run dev -w @emobility/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @emobility/api && node --test tests/foundation.test.mjs tests/mobility-unit.test.mjs tests/rental-rules.test.mjs tests/rental-search.test.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests docs AGENTS.md README.md package.json compose.yaml .github/workflows
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests docs AGENTS.md README.md package.json compose.yaml .github/workflows
